fixtures.origin: Synthetic AIXM 5.2 documents written by `spec/build_fixtures.py` on 2026-09-21 (phase 6) for a reading the harness fixtures cannot carry or that deserves its own file, mirroring the aixm511 set: the EPSG:4326 / CRS84 axis-order pair (the same numbers, two places), an interior ring of curves (too deep for a shipped twin), a composition with a cycle of contributor references, every reference form, twelve ways of stating a vertical limit, nil / absent / withdrawn property states, a schema-valid BASELINE with a TimeInstant that breaks Temporality Concept rule TS_001, and two features outside the families (a 5.2 DME with location, availability and tuningFrequencyVHF; a Taxiway with two availability structures) whose ledger-bound elements the generic reading carries. Read by name in `tests/test_cdm_aixm52_adapter.py`; every one validates against the pinned 5.2 XSD (BLOCKED, never a pass, without the resource) and is INVALID against 5.1.1 once its namespaces are rewritten. Fictitious identifiers (a1a40000-0520-) and positions throughout.
